How it helps

Three simple jobs.
One clearer view.

A workflow concept designed around the information care teams need to follow wound progress.

01

Capture

Keep wound photos with the right notes, dates and care information.

02

Compare previous and current records so changes are easier to see.

03

Why it matters

Information that supports the care conversation.

Scattered photos, notes and review dates make wound progress harder to follow. Spotit brings the workflow together, with a focus on review visibility and clearer communication.

Designed for hospitals, clinics, care and nursing homes, new care services and healthcare start-ups.

Spotit’s current stage and clinical role

Spotit is offered at its current stage as an idea, workflow, app concept, documentation and intellectual property opportunity. Final clinical safety sign-off, testing, regulatory assessment, pilot approval and live deployment compliance would need to be completed by the buyer or deploying organisation.
